resources.string: Finds the current video timeline and seeks backward or forward by the configured number of seconds when you tap a floating button.
Drop here to turn off floating controls
Tip: Drag the floating controls onto the ✕ at the bottom of the screen to turn them off.
Pin a toggle in the notification shade

Show a Media Float Button notification with an on/off action. The app reposts it if dismissed while this switch is on. If it does not appear, check that notifications are allowed in Android Settings → Apps → Media Float Button → Notifications.
Floating controls are on — tap for settings
Floating controls are off — tap for settings

Touch and hold an empty spot on the home screen, then choose Widgets → Media Float Button. Tap the one-cell widget to toggle the controls. If you have the old two-cell widget, remove it and add it again.
Use the floating « ‹ ⏯ › » buttons to seek or play and pause the current video. Drag to move the controls. By default, ‹ and › seek by 5 seconds and ⏯ is shown in the middle.
Check a box to show that button. Set how many seconds each tap seeks (1–600). To keep just one button, uncheck the others. The floating buttons show symbols only, not the number of seconds.
Could not play or pause the current video
Keep at least one control enabled
Could not seek in the current video

Finds and moves the video timeline when the player cannot be controlled through Android media controls. The app inspects the current screen only when you use a control. If the switch is unavailable on Xiaomi, go to App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings.
Used to find active media sessions. The app does not read notification contents.
No active media session found. Open a video and come back, or try seeking using Accessibility.
The command could not be sent. Check the permissions above and make sure the video is on screen.

Android does not let an ordinary app send ←/→ keystrokes to the browser. Media Float Button uses Android media controls when available, or uses Accessibility to move the timeline. Some custom players do not expose a timeline, so seeking may not work.
